title: prefill + decode pipeline: chunked prefill, speculative prefill, stage-overlap and scheduler optimizations
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Improves end-to-end throughput and p99 latency for long-context workloads by enabling chunked prefill, speculative prefill paths, and more aggressive stage overlap and kernel scheduling heuristics. No user-facing API changes.
description: Motivation: prefill->decode pipeline hotspots were limiting throughput for long-context workloads and bursty request patterns. This PR combines three related optimizations: 1) chunked prefill: break large prefill requests into smaller prefill chunks to reduce memory pressure and allow earlier decode progress; 2) speculative prefill: opportunistically initiate decode kernels for top-k tokens from partially-prefilled segments to increase hardware utilization; 3) stage overlap + scheduler improvements: allow prefill and decode stages to overlap more aggressively across micro-batches and add a kernel-aware scheduler that prefers compact KV-cache placements and coalesces small decode work into continuous-batching opportunities. Changes in this PR were driven by ENG-9342 and follow-on perf investigations. Summary of changes: - runtime/inference/prefill: new ChunkedPrefillPlan and chunking logic, chunk size heuristics based on sequence length distribution; kv_cache: incremental kv-merge API to support partial prefill commits; - runtime/scheduler: KernelScheduler refactor with new scoring for co-location, memory headroom, and expected latency; continuous-batching now merges compatible decode tasks across micro-batches when kernel occupancy would otherwise be low; - decode path: speculative token path that executes a lightweight top-k pass for partially available KV cache, with safe rollback on misprediction; - tests: new e2e perf harness scenarios, unit tests for chunked prefill and kv-merge, and mock kernel tests for scheduler scoring. Commits: ["a1b2c3d: implement chunked prefill plan and heuristics", "d4e5f6g: incremental KV merge API + tests", "h7i8j9k: kernel scheduler refactor and scoring", "l0m1n2o: speculative prefill decode path + rollback", "p3q4r5s: e2e perf tests and CI config updates"]. Changed files (high-level): ["runtime/inference/prefill.rs", "runtime/kv/kv_cache.rs", "runtime/scheduler/kernel_scheduler.rs", "runtime/decode/speculative.rs", "runtime/batching/continuous.rs", "tests/perf/long_context_harness.py", "docs/perf/notes/prefill-chunking.md"]. Impact: +8-18% aggregated throughput on our internal long-context benchmark, p99 decode latency reduced by up to 12% in bursty traffic scenarios. Memory peak reduced ~10% for 32k-context reference runs. Migration and safety: feature gated under runtime flag "enable_prefill_chunking" and speculative path off by default. Rollout plan: staged canary on dedicated infra, followed by default enablement for batch workloads.
